# How-to

What a user of the catalog does, step by step, and the rules each step meets. This list is generated from the pages of the folder; edit the pages, never this file.

- [Choose a category and subcategory](Choose-a-category-and-subcategory.md): Pick the category first, then a subcategory that belongs to it.
- [Create a product through a draft](Create-a-product-through-a-draft.md): Create a product by filling a private draft and saving it, so it appears in the catalog only when complete.
- [Edit, save, keep or discard a draft](Edit-save-keep-or-discard-a-draft.md): Change an existing product through a draft, then save it, leave it for later or discard it.
- [Fill the details of a product](Fill-the-details-of-a-product.md): Enter the typed details that the product's subcategory asks for, such as colour or weight.
- [Find a product](Find-a-product.md): Narrow the list of products by name, category, price or rating, and read the draft markers in the list.
- [Import products from Excel](Import-products-from-Excel.md): Create many products at once from an .xlsx workbook, all or nothing, with every bad row reported.
- [Who may do what](Who-may-do-what.md): Which actions each of the two catalog roles may use, and what an unsigned user gets.
